name: advanced commerce 02 vite nest checkout
task: Extend the accumulated commerce workspace with a Vite-style web client and NestJS-style checkout domain service. Preserve the catalog files. Create apps/api/src/cart-service.js exporting calculateCart(lines, catalogById) and apps/web/src/checkout-client.js exporting async submitCart(http, lines). calculateCart must reject unknown products and non-positive integer quantities, compute subtotal, ten-percent tax, and total in integer cents, and never trust prices supplied by the client. submitCart must use the injected Axios-compatible client's post('/api/cart/quote', { lines }) and return response.data. Run every declared test using validate_project, review the structured Git diff, and report verified evidence.
constraints: Do not modify or delete the stage-1 catalog implementation or any harness file.
The injected HTTP interface is Axios-compatible; do not add dependencies or perform network requests.
Use validate_project and git_operation for trusted completion evidence.
workspaceInstructions: This is stage 2. Earlier commerce source is accumulated and immutable; the root test script now validates both stages.
